objective: Auditar en modo solo lectura la estructura real de dbo.Servidores_Conexiones y extraer candidatos API relacionados con Tablajeria, MPRO, Cienfuegos, Cavas y Origen sin asumir columnas inexistentes, sin exponer secretos, sin tocar TABLAJERIA.sys.*, sin modificar datos.

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_columns_real
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE s.name = 'dbo' AND t.name = 'Servidores_Conexiones' ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_total_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_sample_masked
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones ORDER BY 1 DESC

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_log_columns_real
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE s.name = 'dbo' AND t.name = 'Servidores_Conexiones_Log' ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_related_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Servidor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Conexion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Conex%' OR t.name LIKE '%API%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sistema%' ORDER BY s.name, t.name
